reason: Expert provides a confirmed fix for a cell remaining down after a power outage on older base stations using a cold restart of the baseband.

knowledge.summary: On older base stations, after a power outage, a normal software reboot does not bring the cell up; a cold restart of the baseband unit is required.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto
knowledge.details: Power off completely, wait 30 sec, power on.
